steps.title: Initial audit
steps.text: We look at your Instagram, 2GIS and website, if you have one. We walk the customer's path to a request and show where people drop off.

steps.title: Plan and price
steps.text: We suggest what to do first and fix the cost and timeline before any work starts.

steps.title: We build
steps.text: We make the website, ads or sales setup. You see work-in-progress versions and give feedback.

steps.title: Turnkey launch
steps.text: Hosting, domain, setup and deployment are entirely on us. You get a technically finished website that already works and takes requests. After launch we stay in touch for edits and next steps.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.draftNote: This is a draft. Company details and the final text will be added after approval.

sections.title: 1. Who processes the data
sections.text: Data controller: {entity}, BIN {bin}. Address: {address}. Contact for data questions: {email}.

sections.title: 2. What data we receive
sections.text: The name, phone or messenger username, business niche and comment you enter in the request form. The form on this website stores nothing: the request text is passed to the messenger you choose (Telegram or WhatsApp), and you send it to us yourself.

sections.title: 3. Why
sections.text: To contact you, run the initial audit and prepare an offer. We do not sell or share data with third parties except where required by law.

sections.title: 4. How long we keep it
sections.text: No longer than needed to answer your request and work with you, or until you ask us to delete it.

sections.title: 5. Analytics and cookies
sections.text: Analytics services are enabled only after you consent in the cookie banner. Without consent they are not loaded.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
sections.text: You can request, correct or delete your data by writing to us. Processing follows the Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan “On Personal Data and Their Protection”.
